title: Cycle
heroNoData: Log your first period to get started
startPeriodActionSubtitle: When you start your period here, LifeSort tracks length and patterns, then estimates your next period.
endPeriodActionSubtitle: Save the end date so your calculations and calendar become more precise.
journalSubtitle: Register flow, symptoms, and notes in seconds.
wheelHelper: Drag around the wheel to explore the coming days.
trackingDisclaimer: Cycle estimates are based on your logged cycles and current cycle settings, and can be inaccurate. Do not use these estimates as contraception.
calendarA11ySummary: Calendar legend: logged periods are recorded data. Fertile windows, ovulation, and next periods are estimates based on logged cycles and current cycle settings.
calendarStaleA11ySummary: Calendar prediction estimates need updating. Logged periods remain recorded data.
wheelA11ySummary: Cycle wheel. Future phases and the next-period countdown are estimates based on logged cycles and current cycle settings.
wheelStaleA11ySummary: Cycle wheel prediction estimates need updating. Cycle day remains based on your logged start.
reminderGenericNotifBody: You have a reminder in LifeSort.
reminderRichNotifTitle: Your period is estimated to start soon
reminderRichNotifBody_one: Based on your logged cycles and cycle settings, it is estimated to start in {{count}} day.
reminderRichNotifBody_other: Based on your logged cycles and cycle settings, it is estimated to start in {{count}} days.
reminderToggleHint: Get notified the day before your estimated next period.
richNotificationCopyLabel: Show cycle details on lock screen

insightsSubtitle: Found in your own data across the app
